<thought>To construct a valid retrosynthetic route, I will first find a template that disconnects an ether bond (retro‑SN2 ether formation). In the forward direction this reaction forms an ether from an alcohol and a good leaving group (e.g., alkyl halide). Therefore, I will search the template catalog for reactions that **break** “aliphatic hydroxyls” and **form** “ether oxygens”. Then I will apply the most suitable template to the target molecule to obtain precursor fragments. After obtaining the precursors, I will verify that each step is valid with verify_step and that the leaf fragments are commercially available with is_buyable. Finally, I will assemble the route in the required JSON format.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
